# HAPI v0.30.4.1 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from official GitHub Release `v0.30.4` at `8cefb0f04c413d4f47cd364bcf556e03af6b4073` with 155 current open PRs audited: 27 carry, 124 defer, 4 drop.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.1.1`:

- Rebase onto official `v0.30.4`. Inherit official `v0.30.0` through `v0.30.4` (including Android default push through the official relay, shared Codex session restore, chat grouping, input-request notification distinction, and Codex plan implement RPC) without replaying already-upstreamed work.
- Keep the same 27-carry overlay, including `#1771` native `hapi-session-runtime`, project labels (`#1635`), hidden-agent picker (`#1451`), single-machine label omission (`#1414`), filter-time group collapse (`#1797`), PWA icons (`#1625`), unified sync labels (`#1617`), and single-line fork/rewind confirm copy (`#1603`).
- Retain the fork PID-reuse lock from `swear01/hapi#19`.
- Remount Hub upgrade offer and CLI artifact routes (`/api/upgrade`, `/cli/upgrade`) that the `v0.29.1.1` binary omitted, so standalone Hub can serve fleet upgrade offers again.
- Personal `#1822` and `#1819` stay deferred. New open `#1847`, `#1846`, `#1844`, `#1838`, plus `#1836`, `#1831`, `#1826`, and `#1825` are deferred this round.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.30.4`, includes the maintained desktop, fleet upgrades, imports, model-error handling, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol V2 overlay, session-roots guard, and the audited changes above.

Existing explicit drops remain in effect: `#1320` Antigravity is not replayed; `#1091` managed provider profiles stay dropped; `#1093`/`#1597` assistant response navigation stay dropped; `#1424` Jobs stay excluded because stale running jobs can pin inactive sessions.

## Personal PR policy exceptions

`#1771` is merge-dirty against the new official tip and spans a large integration surface; keep it as the native session-runtime skill (`PERSONAL_PR_POLICY_EXCEPTION`). `#1635` is a merge-dirty personal carry kept as focused overlay behavior. `#1419` is a ready personal carry. `#1822` and `#1819` are not carried this round.

## Distribution

Standalone four-part maintenance release, with signed macOS CLI archives, Linux and Windows CLI archives, Windows/macOS desktop bundles, and `checksums.txt`. Optional platform packages remain on official `0.30.4`. The implicit standalone upgrade channel remains off.
